item.title: Show HN: Counterbranch - See how your PR changes access permissions (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: Hey all, we just released the first alpha version of Counterbranch as a GitHub Action, and are looking for feedback. Broken access control is still #1 in the OWASP Top 10. A small code change can alter who gets access. Counterbranch flags changes to recognized guards, permissions, endpoints, and policy files as a comment right in your pull request. The scan runs without an LLM or API key. Link goes directly to the GitHub action marketplace listing to install and test in your existing workflow. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49973887 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

item.title: Show HN: Counterbranch - See how your PR changes access control (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
item.description: Hi, we just released Counterbranch as a GitHub Action (alpha) and are looking for feedback. The action scans your codebase looking for unintended changes to authorization. This can happen in custom code, endpoints, guards, rbac, abac, policy-as-code files, etc. and can lead to broken access control or data exposure. The scanner doesn't use LLMs and is blazing fast. The results show up as a comment on each pull request so you can maintain and improve authz for any volume of human and agentic coders. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49973798 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
